items.label: Macro
items.detail: 10Y Treasury ~4.72% near 1yr high; Strait of Hormuz crisis + sticky oil keep Fed path two-sided (Sept hike odds ~35%); gold ~$4,400-4,530/oz on debasement bid (live web, 2026-08-18/20).

diversification_actions.action: Add IEF (7-10yr US Treasuries) as core ballast
diversification_actions.rationale: IEF's weekly-return correlation to the 69%-of-NAV S&P 500 block (SPY5) is +0.16 over the past year — the lowest of every candidate tested — at just 4.4% annualized vol, so it dampens equity drawdowns with minimal tracking noise.

diversification_actions.action: Add TLT (20+yr US Treasuries) for convex growth-scare protection
diversification_actions.rationale: TLT correlates +0.17 to the S&P 500 block; its long duration gives more convex upside if the Fed eases into a growth scare, though it is 0.91 correlated with IEF so the two should be sized together as one duration sleeve, not stacked.

diversification_actions.action: Scale up the existing IGLN gold sleeve toward ~12-15%
diversification_actions.rationale: Gold correlates +0.33 to the S&P block and only +0.42 to Treasuries, so it is an independent hedge that also covers the inflation/debasement and Middle-East (Hormuz) scenario bonds miss — unlike ex-US equity ETFs VEA (+0.65) and VWO (+0.66), which the data shows would NOT diversify this book.
